::: {#def-relation-power}
#### Power of a relation

Let $R$ be a relation on a set $S$ (@rem-relation-on-set).
The **powers** of $R$ are the relations $R^n$ on $S$,
for integers $n \ge 1$,
given by the recursive definition (@def-recursive-definition)

- base case: $R^1 = R$;
- recursive rule: $R^{n + 1} = R^n \circ R$ for $n \ge 1$ (@def-relation-composition).

:::
